The lead
Costume

The Performance

Lady Ondine advances down an endless hall while the drowned dead pour toward her. Her rapier sings on its own: attacks are automatic. Guide her with the mouse, A/D or the arrow keys, or by dragging on a touch screen.

The Diva cannot fall. Her health is unlimited. A hit staggers her for a moment and breaks her combo, and the combo multiplies both score and coins. End a performance from the Intermission (P or Esc) to bank your coins.

Gilded Gates

Pairs of gates drift toward you. Walk through one side to claim it: more bolts (up to 20), attack speed (up to 30 a second), power (no limit), critical chance (up to 75%) or coins. Shoot a gate to raise its number, even a crimson, negative one.

Arias

Five arias answer her call. Space Bubble Shield: three seconds untouchable. F Chrono Bubble: time nearly stops for enemies and their attacks. R Salon Ensemble: three spirits sing homing notes. E Riptide Waltz: a breaking wave that hurls enemies back and erases bullets. Q Grand Finale: fills as you fight; a storm of water spears and double tempo.

Instruments

Cases lie in the hall. Walk over one to take up a new instrument for a while: the Coral Scattergun, the Rain Gatling, the Prism Lance (a piercing beam), the Geyser Launcher (explosive) and the Bubble Seeker (homing).

Favours of the Audience

Glowing gems: Tsunami clears the hall, Frost Note slows the world, Fortissimo doubles damage, Allegro doubles tempo, Bubble Ward blocks three hits, Encore Echo summons two mirror-Ondines, Standing Ovation doubles score and coins, Riptide Edge lets bolts pierce, Encore Call refreshes every aria, and the Coin Purse needs no explanation.

Encores & Billing

Between acts the house demands an encore: choose one of three gifts that last for the rest of the performance. Legendary encores follow great adversaries. Backstage, choose the evening’s billing: a Matinee is forgiving, a Gala is merciless but pays far more. Beware crowned elites, Choir Cantors who heal their allies, and Tolling Bells that summon the drowned.

The Recital Hall

A different performance entirely. Notes stream down four lanes toward the footlights; strike them as they arrive with D F J K or the arrow keys, and hold the long ones. The melody only sounds when you play it. Keep the applause up, or the curtain falls.

The Story

The main campaign. Explore the Grand Aqueduct, meet the company and fight in turn-based party battles. Basic actions restore shared Harmony; skills spend it. Each performer charges their own Finale, usable between any two actions. The order of play is shown at the top left. Strike a foe with an affinity it is weak to (Tide, Brass or Choir) to Break it: delayed and vulnerable.

The Drowned Isles

An open expedition. Roam a sunken world of four districts from the Opera Plaza: WASD to walk, drag the mouse or ←/→ to turn, Space to dash, F to interact, C for the Chrono Bubble, M for the map. Attune Tuning Forks to bank coins and travel, open gilded cases, commune with Echo Shrines, recover twelve Lost Arias, and silence each district’s lair to open the next gate. Spend resonance in the Conservatory. Faint, and half your unbanked coins are lost.

The Masquerade

Survive twenty waves of masked dancers. Your instruments play themselves; levelling up lets you choose how you grow, and between waves the masked merchant sells instruments (up to six, each raised to tier IV) and trinkets. Every fifth wave, an adversary joins the dance.

The Journey

Every fifth act a great adversary takes the stage: the Abyssal Warden, the Drowned Kraken Matriarch, the Phantom Conductor and the Hollow Leviathan. Each has three phases. Watch for red lanes on the floor, walls of bullets with a single gap, and golden orbs that must break before the Conductor can be hurt. Defeat one and the company travels onward: the Grand Aqueduct, the Drowned Library, the Coral Opera, and the Abyssal Cathedral.
